fixture_window_note: NHL fixtures cover the four matchdays 22-25 October 2026 as published on NHL.com; MLB covers World Series games 1-5, 23-28 October 2026; snooker covers every Round 3 match of the BetVictor Northern Ireland Open scheduled on 22 October 2026 on the official WST matches page.

hold.why: Our published prices are FAIR opening lines: decimal price = 1/probability with no overround added. This is deliberate. The owner asked for high-confidence picks priced between -250 and +10000; -250 is exactly a 71.43% implied probability, so any fair price shorter than -250 can only come from a probability above 71.43%. With no hold, the requested band is precisely the 70.00%-71.43% probability window, and that is the window the published high-confidence set is drawn from.

home_edge_goals.why: NHL home teams out-score visitors by a little under a quarter of a goal per game on average. Applied to the projected margin before the probability is taken.

home_edge_runs.why: MLB home teams out-score visitors by about 0.15 runs per game. Applied to the projected run margin.

sigma_margin_nhl.why: Standard deviation of the goal margin of an NHL game. Fixed here because the sandbox could not pull game-level results; the value is the long-run league figure.

sigma_total_nhl.why: Standard deviation of the total goals in an NHL game, used for over/under pricing.

sigma_margin_mlb.why: Standard deviation of the run margin of an MLB game, used for the run line and moneyline probabilities.

sigma_total_mlb.why: Standard deviation of total runs in an MLB game.

shrink_margin_games.why: Pseudo-games at zero goal differential used to shrink early-season goal differential (a team with 7-11 games played is not yet 7-11 games proven).

shrink_rate_games.why: Pseudo-games at the league scoring average used to shrink early-season goals for and against before the projected total is built.

shrink_win_games.why: Pseudo-games at .500 used to shrink the win rate feeding the independent stability check.

mlb_shrink_games.why: Pseudo-games at zero run differential for MLB, whose 162-game samples need much less shrinkage than an NHL October sample.

league_goals_per_team.why: League average goals per team per game used as the shrinkage target for totals. Recomputed from the captured standings table on every build (see build note) rather than hard-coded at run time.
